name: Benteler Automotive Corporation
old_description: Since the company was founded by Carl Benteler in 1876, foresight has been the foundation of our success. From trading to manufacturing, from a regional supplier to an international technology leader – BENTELER has always moved ahead while others hesitated.
about:
Benteler Automotive Corporation, headquartered in Goshen, Indiana, traces its roots to 1876 when Carl Benteler opened a small hardware store in Bielefeld, Germany. The family-founded enterprise evolved from trading into a global metal-processing specialist, now operating as a tier 1 automotive supplier with a presence in 25 countries.

The company manufactures chassis components, module assemblies, and precision steel tubes—both seamless and welded—along with free-cutting steel tubes that replace machined bar stock. Core processes include stamping, assembly, tube forming, and steel production, supported by tool shops and engineering hubs across roughly 90 locations worldwide. The group employs more than 20,000 people.

Benteler serves the automotive industry as a primary customer, supplying OEMs with structural and safety-critical parts, while its steel/tube division serves energy and industrial markets with high-load-capacity tubing for applications such as pipelines and machinery.

The company emphasizes pioneering spirit and sustainability, aiming to make mobility safer and more sustainable through integrated systems like its highly integrated crash management system and material innovations that reduce weight and coating steps.
